description.value: COBS Bread is a Canadian bakery franchise (part of the Bakers Delight family) with over 190 locations across Canada, each baking all products fresh from scratch on-site every day. The Davie Street location is a takeaway-only counter-service bakery offering a wide range of breads, buns, pastries, bagels, scones, cruffins, and savoury items including pizza. Leftover baked goods are donated to local charities at the end of each day.
